transcript.content: Hello, welcome to the clinic. What brings you in to see me today?

I came in because I’m having a hard time at work. I can’t make myself go near the front windows or that part of the street anymore, and I keep making excuses to stay in the back, even though being up front is part of my job.
Is there something specific outside those front windows or on that part of the street that you're afraid of?

It’s mainly that area by the front windows and the street right outside. I don’t feel like I can go over there anymore. I keep coming up with reasons to stay in the back, even when I’m supposed to be up front for work.
Are you avoiding that area because you're afraid of having a panic attack or some other uncomfortable feeling there?

Not really a panic attack, no. It’s more that I just can’t make myself go near those front windows or that part of the street anymore. I keep finding excuses to stay in the back, even though I know I’m supposed to be up front for work.
Is there something specific about the front windows or that part of the street that you're afraid of or trying to avoid?

It’s that spot itself, I guess—the front windows and the street right outside. I just feel like I can’t go near it now. I keep making excuses to stay in the back, even though I know being up front is part of my job.
Is there something in particular that you think might happen to you if you were to go near the front windows or that part of the street?

I don’t know if I can name one exact thing I think will happen. I just know I can’t make myself go near those front windows or that stretch of street anymore. When I’m at work, I keep coming up with reasons to stay in the back, even though I’m supposed to be up front too.
Is there something specific about that area by the front windows or the street that you're trying to avoid?

It’s just that area itself, yeah. The front windows and the street right outside them. I can’t make myself go over there anymore, so I keep finding reasons to stay in the back, even though I know that’s part of my job.
Is there something specific about that area that scares you or makes you want to avoid it?

Yeah, it’s that front area itself—the windows and the street right outside. I don’t really have a better way to explain it, I just can’t make myself go near it now. I keep staying in the back and making excuses, even though I know I’m supposed to work up front too.
Is there something outside those front windows that you're afraid of seeing?

It’s not really one specific thing I’m afraid of seeing. It’s more like I can’t make myself go near those windows or that part of the street at all. I just keep staying in the back and making excuses, even though I’m supposed to be up there too.
Is there something specific that you fear might happen or something specific you fear seeing when you're near the front windows or that part of the street?

I don’t think it’s one specific thing I’m afraid I’ll see, or one exact thing I think will happen. It’s just… being near those front windows and that part of the street makes me freeze up, and I can’t make myself go over there. I keep making excuses to stay in the back, even though I know I’m supposed to be working up front too.
Is there something in that area that you used to be able to tolerate but now can't?

Yeah. Before, I could work up front by the windows or go by that part of the street without thinking about it. Now I just can’t make myself do it. I keep staying in the back and coming up with excuses, even though I know it’s part of my job.
Is there something specific about that area that you're afraid of?

It’s not really one specific thing, I guess. It’s that area itself now—the front windows, that stretch of the street. I just can’t make myself go near it anymore, and I keep finding excuses to stay in the back even though I’m supposed to be up there for work.
Is there something that you think will happen to you if you go to that area that is causing you to avoid it?

I don’t know if I can say exactly what I think will happen. I just know when I get near the front windows or that part of the street, I feel like I can’t do it. So I avoid it and stay in the back, even though I know I’m supposed to be working up there too.
Is there something in particular that you're afraid of when you think about being near the front windows or that part of the street?

I can’t really pin it on one exact thing happening. It’s just when I think about being near those front windows or that part of the street, I freeze up and feel like I can’t make myself go there. So I stay in the back and make excuses, even though I know it’s part of my job.
Is there something outside those windows or on that street that you're afraid of?

Not really one specific thing outside, no. It’s more that the windows and that stretch of street just make me feel like I can’t go over there. I keep staying in the back and making excuses, even though I know I’m supposed to work up front too.
Is there something outside those front windows or on that street that you're afraid will happen to you if you go there?

I don’t know if it’s one thing I’m afraid will happen. I just know I can’t make myself go near those front windows or that part of the street anymore. I keep finding excuses to stay in the back, even though I know that’s part of my job.
Is there something that you used to be able to do or be near without a problem, but now you avoid because of how it makes you feel?

Yeah. I used to be fine working up front by the windows, or being on that part of the street. Now I avoid it. I keep staying in the back and coming up with excuses, even though I know I’m supposed to be able to do that part of my job.
Do you think something bad would happen to you if you went near the front windows or that part of the street?

I don’t know if I can say exactly that something bad would happen. It’s more like I just can’t make myself go near those front windows or that part of the street. I end up making excuses to stay in the back, even though I know that’s part of my job.
Do you think something bad would happen to you if you went near the front windows or that part of the street because of something that happened to you in the past?

Yeah… I think it’s connected to what happened before. I don’t know that I can say exactly what I think will happen, but ever since then I just can’t make myself go near those front windows or that part of the street. I keep making excuses to stay in the back, even though I know it’s part of my job.
Can you tell me what happened before that's causing you to avoid the front windows and that part of the street now?

It’s mainly that I just can’t make myself go near the front windows or that part of the street anymore. That’s why I came in. I keep finding excuses to stay in the back, even though I know that’s supposed to be part of my job.
Did something traumatic happen to you near the front windows or that part of the street?

Yes… that’s the area I can’t deal with now. I came in because I can’t make myself go near the front windows or that part of the street anymore. I keep finding reasons to stay in the back, even though I know that’s supposed to be part of my job.
